lead: Four names cleared the ACT bar today, but the clearest trigger among them is speculative, not fundamental: Bandhan Bank (+9.21%, ₹214 Cr delivered) is running on an unconfirmed media report that Abu Dhabi's IHC is exploring the promoter stake — which the bank itself has denied knowledge of — worth watching for confirmation, not acting on in size. HCL Technologies' ACT-tier rally (+7.94%, ₹954 Cr delivered) looks larger than its Q2FY27 numbers justify on a strict read (PAT only +2.2% YoY despite an 11.5% revenue beat). The best fundamental story in the ENTIRE scan isn't even ACT tier — it's WATCH-tier Shriram Finance (PAT +59.8% YoY) and Caliber Mining & Logistics (STRONG J-curve tag on a 5x order-book step-change) — both covered as full reports below.
caveats: No company in today's top-10 EPS-thesis set had a cached rerating-catalysts brief or filing-extract hit — every brief was built fresh this run (briefCacheHits=0, briefExtractHits=0); the pre-processing queue has no coverage on today's names yet.

The 3 full rerating-catalysts reports (TCS, HCL Technologies, Shriram Finance) were rendered as HTML widgets only, not PDF — this run's environment has no ARM64-compatible Chrome for Puppeteer to render the PDF; Drive links are unset for the same reason (yarn data:push did not complete within this run's time budget — see footer).

Stockscans' own growth-catalyst/concall-notes cache (WHY rung 3a) was cold for all 10 EPS-thesis names today — every brief had to be built from this run's own document reads rather than served from that cache.

NSE:HCLTECH.headline: Q2FY27 revenue beat (+11.5% YoY) but PAT growth soft (+2.2% YoY) — rally looks ahead of the numbers
thesisChain: Revenue ₹35,620 Cr, +11.5% YoY, +3.0% QoQ
but Net Income ₹5,132 Cr grew only +2.2% YoY on an 18.2% EBIT margin diluted by restructuring costs

so the +7.94%, ₹954 Cr-delivery ACT-tier reaction looks bigger than the quantified profit growth justifies — market likely crediting the AI-bookings story ($3,258M TCV, $219M Advanced AI revenue) instead

why.text: Q2FY27 results + investor release (12-Oct-2026) are the proximate filing, but PAT growth (+2.2% YoY) is too modest on its own to explain an ACT-tier, ₹954 Cr-delivery move — flagged mismatched.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: PAT +2.2% YoY is far below the 30% YoY threshold and even below revenue growth — a margin-dilutive quarter, not a re-rating inflection.
epsThesis.thesis: Revenue beat undercut by muted profit growth; GenAI/Advanced-AI revenue ($219M) and large bookings ($3,258M TCV) are the standout optionality, not yet flowing through to PAT.

NSE:BANDHANBNK.headline: M&A rumour (Abu Dhabi IHC exploring promoter stake) — company denies any knowledge
thesisChain: Moneycontrol report (13-Oct) says IHC is exploring a promoter-stake acquisition
stock jumped 9.02% intraday on the report
Bandhan's own Reg-30 clarification says it has no knowledge of any such negotiation — purely speculative, fade risk if unconfirmed

why.text: Exchange-mandated clarification filing directly addresses the move — rumour-driven, explicitly denied by the company, not a fundamental catalyst.

NSE:BSOFT.headline: Named an OpenAI Select Partner — real AI-theme catalyst, but no deal value disclosed
thesisChain: Birlasoft named an OpenAI Select Partner (8-Oct press release)
positions Birlasoft in the OpenAI Partner Network for enterprise AI delivery
no revenue/TCV figure disclosed — sentiment/optionality tailwind, not yet an EPS number

why.text: Genuine AI-alliance announcement timed with the move; unquantified but plausible, and corroborated by a broader same-day IT-sector move.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Unquantified strategic alliance — cannot clear the PAT/revenue inputs of the J-curve rubric.
epsThesis.thesis: OpenAI Select Partner status is a real AI-theme tailwind with no disclosed deal value yet.

NSE:PNCINFRA.headline: Only filing is an immaterial Kazakhstan subsidiary incorporation — move unexplained
thesisChain: Incorporated a pre-revenue subsidiary in Kazakhstan (roads/highways)
charter capital ~₹5 lakh-equivalent — immaterial against PNC's balance sheet
doesn't plausibly account for an ACT-tier, ₹60 Cr-delivery, +11.23% move; checked catalyst/concall/sector — none found

why.text: A filing exists but is immaterial — checked catalyst, concall and sector, found nothing that explains the size of today's move.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Only filing is immaterial; no EPS-moving fact disclosed.
epsThesis.thesis: No EPS-accretive catalyst from today's filing.

NSE:TCS.headline: Q2FY27 results beat — PAT +15.0% YoY, EPS ₹38.37
thesisChain: Revenue ₹73,188 Cr, +11.2% YoY
2nd interim dividend ₹12/share — steady double-digit compounding, not a re-rating event

why.text: Q2FY27 results are a genuine, broad-based beat and plausibly explain the delivery-backed buying.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: PAT +15.0% YoY is a good quarter but well under the 30% J-curve threshold — steady-grower confirmation, not an inflection.
epsThesis.thesis: Broad-based double-digit revenue/PAT growth; EPS impact positive-but-incremental.

NSE:SHRIRAMFIN.headline: Strongest fundamentals in today's scan — PAT +59.8% YoY (Q1FY27) — but no fresh filing explains TODAY's move
thesisChain: Q1FY27 (Jul-2026): AUM ₹3.14 lakh Cr (+15.3% YoY), NII +33.7% YoY, PAT +59.8% YoY, ROA 3.93%
EPS +29.4% YoY lagging PAT growth points to dilution from a capital raise (book value/share +48.5% YoY, unverified)
separately completed a ~$460M senior-notes buyback (30-Sep), but neither filing is from the 7-day scoring window — today's specific trigger is UNEXPLAINED despite the strong underlying story

why.text: No filing in the 7-day scoring window explains today specifically; strongest available explanation is the Q1FY27 profitability inflection, dated.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: PAT +59.8% YoY and NII +33.7% YoY clear the 30% bar with ROA improving to 3.93%; capped at MODERATE pending a fake-J-curve/XBRL audit this run didn't have time to complete, and an unverified capital-raise signal (book value/share +48.5% YoY).
epsThesis.thesis: Clear profitability inflection for India's largest vehicle-finance NBFC; Q2FY27 results (not yet filed) are the direct test of whether it continues.

NSE:CMLL.headline: STRONG J-curve tag — order book 5x FY26 revenue, CRISIL upgrade — but dated, not today's news
thesisChain: Order book stepped from ₹5,668 Cr to ₹9,125 Cr within Q1FY27 (now 5x FY26 revenue)
FY27 guidance: +45-50% revenue, +35%+ EBITDA/PAT
CRISIL upgraded the rating to A-/Positive in Aug-2026, citing the order book and IPO-led deleveraging — genuine EPS-accretion setup, but sourced from a 2-month-old deck with no fresh filing today

why.text: No filing in the 14-day window; the catalyst is real and strong but dated — explains the ongoing re-rating story, not specifically today's move.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Order book step-change (5x FY26 revenue) + FY27 guidance of 45-50% revenue growth + CRISIL rating upgrade — a textbook Large-Orders + new-industry-cycle catalyst.
epsThesis.thesis: Order book of ₹9,125 Cr built on Coal India subsidiary contracts, with management guiding 45-50% FY27 revenue growth and a CRISIL upgrade citing IPO-led deleveraging.

NSE:SHRINGARMS.headline: Highest return in the entire scan (+14.87%) on thin delivery — genuinely unexplained
thesisChain: Q1FY27 revenue +64.9% YoY but PAT only +19.3% YoY with margins compressing 240-420bps (stale, Aug-2026 deck)
no filing in the 14-day window
delivery% is low (5.78%) against the day's outsized return — possible thin-float volatility rather than a fundamentals-driven move

why.text: Checked filings (none), the latest catalyst deck (mixed/stale), concall and sector — nothing confidently explains today's move.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: Revenue growth strong but margins compressing 240-420bps YoY — fails the operating-leverage-confirmed input.
epsThesis.thesis: Revenue scale-up without matching profit flow-through.

NSE:KPITTECH.headline: No company-specific trigger — possible unconfirmed IT-sector sympathy
thesisChain: Q1FY27 (most recent on file): CC revenue roughly flat QoQ, PAT ~₹117 Cr, $257M new deal TCV — soft, no fresh filing
scan's informal 'IT Services' sector tag shows 6 names averaging +8.53% today
but KPIT's own industry tag differs from that cluster and the formal delivery-confirmed sector_clusters output is empty — unconfirmed, not a basis

why.text: No filing, no cached catalyst, no cached concall notes; sector color is informal only.

epsThesis.jCurveReason: No fresh filing; Q1FY27 showed flattish CC revenue QoQ.
epsThesis.thesis: Healthy deal pipeline ($257M TCV) but soft billing conversion.

NSE:63MOONS.headline: No fresh filing — possible unconfirmed IT-sector sympathy
thesisChain: No announcement in the 14-day window; latest result on file is Q1FY27 (Aug-2026)
appears in the scan's informal 'IT Services' sector tag (6 names, avg +8.53% today)
formal delivery-confirmed sector_clusters output is empty — background color only, not a confirmed basis

why.text: No filing, no cached catalyst or concall notes; sector color is informal only.

NSE:VIKRAN.headline: ₹2,941 Cr IREDA term loan finalizes financing for its own ₹3,518 Cr solar EPC order
thesisChain: WOS NOPL signed a ₹2,941.19 Cr rupee term loan with IREDA
financing a 969 MWac/1,163 MWp solar project (152 sites, Maharashtra)
completes financing for the EPC contract already awarded to Vikran Engineering worth ₹3,517.98 Cr — a concrete, quantified order-financing milestone

why.text: Concrete, quantified financing milestone directly tied to Vikran's own EPC order.

NSE:NEWGEN.headline: Only filing is a routine EVP (non-C-suite) retirement — move unexplained
thesisChain: Scanner flagged the filing has_material_ann=true by category
content read: EVP-Global Business Strategy & HR retiring, not a C-suite KMP, no stated business impact
category flag vs. content read is a clean mismatch example — checked catalyst/sector, nothing else found

why.text: Category-level flag said material; content read says routine. No other explanation found.

NSE:SMLMAH.headline: Planned CFO/CHRO transition — orderly succession, not obviously market-moving
thesisChain: CFO cessation (planned exit) + interim CFO + new CFO from 1-Jan-2027 + new CHRO
orderly, board-approved succession, not a crisis departure
doesn't obviously justify a +6.51%, 35.73%-delivery move; checked catalyst/concall/sector — none found

why.text: A filing exists but reads as routine management succession.

NSE:INDIAGLYCO.headline: Highest-return WATCH name (+10.16%) with no proportionate trigger — demerger is old news
thesisChain: Only filings are a demerger cost-apportionment notice (demerger completed via NCLT order Jul-2026, shares allotted Sep-2026 — already priced in) and a trivial ₹6.22 lakh GST penalty
neither plausibly drives a 10%+ move
checked catalyst/concall/sector — none found

why.text: Both filings in the window are stale/administrative or immaterial; genuinely unexplained.

NSE:UTTAMSUGAR.headline: Exchange sought a price-movement clarification on yesterday's move — company denies any undisclosed information
thesisChain: Exchange issued a clarification request on 13-Oct-2026 citing Oct-12's volume/price movement
Uttam Sugar's reply: unaware of any information or impending announcement that would bear on the price; calls the move purely market-driven
same denial pattern as Bandhan Bank — genuinely no company-specific cause found

why.text: Company's own exchange-mandated reply explicitly denies any undisclosed cause; checked catalyst/concall/sector — none found either.
sources: BSE filing 13-Oct-2026 (Reply to Clarification on Price Movement)
